caption: The drawing features two distinct objects on a plain, off-white background. The primary object, located in the upper central portion of the page, is a square with a textured brown surface resembling leather. This square is bordered by a dark brown frame, inside of which is a decorative pattern made up of simple corner flourishes and a repeating border motif along the edges. Below this square, there is a narrow, horizontal rectangular outline rendered solely in black line drawing, without any color fill; it contains two identical, symmetrical stylized corner designs at each end. In the lower right corner of the page, the name "Marie Hanullard" and the date "June 23 – 1936" are inscribed in small, neat print.
title: Leather Medal Case
